name: Elite Among the Shadows
source:
A game about a college student named Gilda who becomes obsessed over the idea of moral hierarchies and decides to murder a janitor that works at her campus to prove her worth. 

[From [url=https://garion-mmm.itch.io/elite-among-the-shadows]Itch.io[/url]]
